race.comment: ROLLING HOME (1) resumes as the horse to beat, with last campaign's second to Tron Bolt in a 2yo Open at Randwick-Kensington reading well for a country maiden. He returns as a gelding and looked very impressive in his latest trial win. Can return with a bang. MACHRIHANISH (11) is race fit and comes off a half-length second at Canberra, with Guymer sticking from that effort. That effort stacks up and she can go one better. IMELDA (6) Has strong claims after a couple of handy trials coming into this event for the Messara & Gavranich stable with stable hoop Bullock in the irons. Can make an impact right away. PARIS KNIGHTS (9) 3yo gelding out of the So You Think mare City Of Love. Four trial seconds give him a solid education for his debut. Watch for any market moves.
